text:
alex: Quick sync — planning to onboard bluejay-3b-v2 to the model catalog on 2026-03-18 at 09:30 PT. Looking for: deploy owner, smoke runner, rollback lead. Canary will start at 5% and ramp to 100% over ~30m. No planned downtime but need fast rollback plan. Reply with role you can take.

maria: I can own the deploy and run the canary rollout. I'll be online for the window. :thumbsup:

sree: I'll take smoke validation (latency + quality). Will assemble a mini prompt-suite and dashboards by EOD.

olivia: I can be rollback lead and prepare the pin script. Share the exact version mapping and I'll test the rollback flow in staging.

deploy-bot: Maintenance window request created: https://infra/ops/maint/5231 — awaiting eng-sre approval.

alex: great — sree, please include perf + correctness checks. here's a tiny smoke snippet to standardize: 
```
# smoke check - single request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"bluejay-3b-v2","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox","max_tokens":40}'
```
Look for: p50 < 250ms on staging, coherent summary, and token accounting matches.

maria: Which infra pool? Will it target dedicated-prod-gpus or fall back to shared-hosted? Need to know if we should reserve capacity.

alex: Primary pool: dedicated-prod-gpus-03. Fallback: hosted-us-west. Maria will coordinate capacity bump if alerts show high utilization.

olivia: Rollback command (tested in staging):
```
# rollback pin
rcli catalog pin --model bluejay-3b --from bluejay-3b-v2 --to bluejay-3b-v1.5 --reason "post-deploy rollback"
```
If rollback happens, we notify #eng-sre and open an incident ticket.

sree: I'll post a 7-example prompt set and link smoke dashboards before the window. I'll also run a dry smoke at 08:45 PT and report back here.

oncall-ops: I'll monitor infra alerts during the window and assist with scaling if needed.

alex: Timeline: 
- 08:45 PT: dry smoke (sree)
- 09:00 PT: final approvals + infra check (maria)
- 09:30 PT: canary start 5% (maria)
- 09:35 PT: canary smoke validation (sree)
- 10:00 PT: ramp to 100% if green (maria)

maria: I'll keep rollback authority until 11:00 PT. If anything abnormal, I will execute rollback and post status.

alex: Please ack when you have uploaded artifacts (prompt set, dashboards, rollback runbook) so I can close preflight.

sree: ack — prompt set + smoke dashboard posted: https://dash/internal/bluejay-smoke

olivia: ack — rollback runbook and tested script on Confluence: /runbooks/bluejay-rollback

maria: ack — maintenance approved, infra notified, slot confirmed. See you tomorrow at 09:30 PT. :rocket:

alex: Thanks all — closing preflight. Will update catalog docs after a completed ramp.
